The bug icon at the top right, next to the Logs: the site's form opens inside the launcher (otherwise in your browser). \"Create the logs zip\", then drag the zip into the form.

Report a bug (the bug icon at the top right, next to the Logs): the site's form opens inside the launcher (Windows 10 and later). \"Create the logs zip\" button at the top of the panel: the zip lands on your Desktop, drag it into the form with what you were doing.

On Windows 7, on Linux or without the WebView2 engine: the form opens in your browser and the zip lands straight on the Desktop. Settings > Launcher > Troubleshooting: \"Report bugs in the browser\" for those who prefer it.
The panel only shows the report site and the Discord sign-in (the padlock and the domain stay visible at the top); any other link opens in your browser.
